ecuparam.name: A2WC511R TCU State BC0*
ecuparam.desc: Raw uint8 ECU RAM byte at physical address 0xFFFF4BC0; adjacent transmission-derived state.

ecuparam.name: A2WC511R Raw Gear/Range A*
ecuparam.desc: Raw uint8 ECU RAM byte at physical address 0xFFFF4BC1; decoded from the upper nibble of 0xFFFF4C8D.

ecuparam.name: A2WC511R TCU State BC3*
ecuparam.desc: Raw uint8 ECU RAM byte at physical address 0xFFFF4BC3; adjacent state consumed with BC1/BC2.

ecuparam.name: A2WC511R Packed Gear/Range Byte*
ecuparam.desc: Raw uint8 ECU RAM byte at physical address 0xFFFF4C8D; OEM decoder splits upper nibble to FFFF4BC1 and lower nibble to FFFF4BC2.
